sources.text: the ledger report is useless to me in the morning. its a wall of numbers and i dont know what to do with it. i want to open tinkery and in like 5 seconds know if yesterday went well or not. maybe one number? useful changes per hour is the one that matters. cost too maybe. i dont want a dashboard. also the 6am job sometimes fails silently and i only find out days later
a failed job should override everything. cost only matters if its way off

parts.situation: In the morning, when I open Tinkery after yesterday's ledger activity
parts.outcome: know whether yesterday went well and whether the 6am job failed
parts.why: so I know what to do with the ledger instead of facing a wall of numbers
parts.proof: It works if I can know in like 5 seconds using useful changes per hour and maybe cost
parts.boundaries: No dashboard; it must not fail silently

unresolved_notes: PROVISIONAL assumption: “useful changes per hour” and cost are candidate signals, not yet defined measures.
PROVISIONAL assumption: “maybe one number” describes a possible presentation, not a confirmed solution.
